name: Shinohara Shuutarou
source: Recently moved to the island of Kamikushima to work as a doctor, only for the only other doctor on the island to leave for a month on a training program. Lazy as well as a self-described loser, although he still seems to try his best. Lives with [url=/c34351]Mana[/url].
